local.description:
With this Mod your Hotbar items will be visible on your Character, with a unique location for a your Shield, Banner and offhand item.

You can turn on or off the visibility for all of them one-by-one.

There you can set things like rotation, position, size, etc.

If the item you want to show up is not visible by default then you have to add it to your whitelist or
if there is an item you dont want to show up then add it to your blacklist.

You can change the position, rotation, size of the items by default in the detailed window.
If you dont like the item settings then you can change that items pos, rot, size in the unique item settings window.

More info at website.

If you find any errors please let me know.
You can find me on curseforge: YourDailyModderx
or
Write in the discord server:
https://discord.gg/FcD5KwQXSK

Thanks for downloading my mod!
